# Drawings for the ¹H NMR preview's diastereotopic rule only (docs/plans/v2-proton-nmr.md,
# decision 3): web/src/chem/protonNmr.test.ts compares the browser's flags with server-side
# RDKit's on them. Not test compounds for shifts: no judgement and no spectra. Each covers a
# case the test compounds don't: a vinyl group (one group and an H at the other end), an =CH2
# whose other end carries two identical groups, a diastereotopic CH2 in an achiral molecule,
# ring CH2 made diastereotopic by a substituent across the ring, and CH2 whose two H are
# mirror images though the molecule has a stereogenic double bond, an exocyclic one, a diazo
# group or an allene (the review). How many CH2 each has whose two H can differ is a person's
# judgement: proton_rules/judged.json.
styrene
2-methylpropene
3-pentanol
methylcyclohexane
ethyl crotonate
trans-3-hexene
ethylidenecyclohexane
ethyl diazoacetate
1,2-pentadiene
